page: Microsoft Azure E96s_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the Esv7 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features a dedicated Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture, providing 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and is equipped with a 480 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. The server is configured with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, but it is Premium Storage capable.

In benchmark evaluations, the E96s_v7 demonstrates strong multi-core processing capabilities, scoring 102,250.79 in stress-ng multi-core tests and 109,110.34 in the PassMark CPU suite. Memory performance is highlighted by a top-tier cached read-only small block bandwidth of 7,543.56 GB/sec, alongside a strong uncached large block read bandwidth of 349.82 GB/sec. The system also excels in data processing tasks, achieving top-tier results in gzip compression (36.46 GB/sec) and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (604.05 GB/sec). Database operations are highly efficient, as evidenced by a top-tier Redis SET throughput of 160.72 million operations per second and a PassMark database score of 33,095.51.

The processor's support for advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE and AMX_INT8), enables accelerated execution of mathematical and cryptographic operations. This is reflected in the top-tier PassMark extended instructions score of 127,838.02 and encryption score of 107,455.51. For machine learning workloads, the server achieves top-tier prompt processing speeds across various model sizes, reaching 4,266.36 tokens/sec for a 135M model and 40.01 tokens/sec for a 70B model. However, text generation speeds are more moderate, averaging 4.66 tokens/sec for the 70B model. Given its high memory density and lack of local storage, this instance is qualitatively cost-effective for memory-bound enterprise workloads, large-scale databases, and in-memory analytics, though users must provision external Premium Storage for persistent data.
description: The Microsoft Azure E96s_v7 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the Esv7 family, powered by a dedicated 4.2 GHz Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor. It features 96 vCPUs (48 physical cores), a 480 MB L3 cache, and 768.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. While it lacks local storage and GPUs, it supports Premium Storage. The server delivers top-tier performance in memory bandwidth (7,543.56 GB/sec cached read), multi-threaded decompression (604.05 GB/sec), and Redis SET operations (160.72 million ops/sec). It also leverages Intel AMX and AVX-512 instructions, achieving top-tier scores in PassMark CPU tests and prompt processing for LLM inference. This configuration is highly suited for memory-intensive workloads, including large-scale database operations, in-memory caching, and enterprise data processing.
